threshold_rationale.all_case_safety: Safety is not an advanced-method differentiator. A baseline that becomes catastrophic in challenge cases is not a safe comparison object, so competence v1 safety and catastrophic limits are retained unchanged.
threshold_rationale.nominal_success_0_70: This is a methodological research gate, not a physically derived number. Fifty percent supplies no clear operational-majority margin; sixty percent permits broad unreliability; seventy percent requires repeatable majority usability while allowing heterogeneous cases; eighty percent would impose near-operational reliability beyond a research baseline.
threshold_rationale.nominal_each_wind_0_50: Prevents calm cases from masking inability to operate in moderate or ordinary stochastic wind. Every nominal condition must succeed on at least a simple majority of its balanced cases.
threshold_rationale.nominal_each_task_0_60: Both mandatory task families must be usable; a ten-point allowance below the aggregate gate accommodates family heterogeneity without permitting one family to be sacrificed.
threshold_rationale.tracking_rmse: The preregistered competence-v1 geometric tracking bounds remain meaningful, but are applied to the operational cohort rather than advanced robustness challenges.
threshold_rationale.deadline: The preregistered one-percent component deadline miss limit remains the real-time validity requirement.

challenge_robustness.purpose: preserve strong sustained, transient, ramp, and multi-link coordination as the space in which advanced methods demonstrate value
